Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You leave the obvious trail and return with the forest’s quiet offerings gathered in your hands.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
One hour per attempt.
Target / range / shape
A viable forest patch; one hour
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Choose food or ordinary plant crafting material; one bundle only, maximum d8. The first step from out creates d4; further steps raise it to d6, then d8. DA establishes whether the patch has usable resources; no repeat harvesting of an exhausted patch.

Weak
Raise one eligible supply by 1 step.
Standard
Raise it by 2 steps.
Strong
Raise it by 3 steps.
